editorial:
Imagine a guy who is totally obsessed with collecting animals. He has built a massive ark and managed to find almost every creature on earth, but there is one big problem. He is missing a Pink Panther! This sets up a hilarious game of cat and mouse in the middle of a wild jungle. You get to watch this eccentric collector try his hardest to catch the cool and collected panther, who spends the whole time making the man look silly. It is a lighthearted, colorful ride that feels like a classic Saturday morning cartoon, blending a bit of adventure with a lot of slapstick humor.

What really makes this one work is the pacing; it never slows down and the physical jokes land perfectly. While it is a short film, the animation is smooth and the timing is spot on. If you enjoy seeing a cocky character get humbled, you will love this. It is a great pick for a quick family movie night. It is a simple, fun watch that doesn't take itself too seriously.
endingExplained: After a long chase where the panther tricks the man at every turn, the hunter finally thinks he has the upper hand. However, the Panther gets the last laugh by outsmarting the man one final time. Instead of being captured and put on the ark, the Panther manages to turn the tables. The man ends up defeated and frustrated, proving that no matter how big your collection is, you can't catch a panther who is this clever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic cartoons and silly humor.
